title: Football positions vocabulary
text: Football players by position: el portero (goalkeeper), el defensa (defender), el centrocampista (midfielder), el delantero (striker). A2 football vocabulary.

concept.name: Player positions
concept.description: Nouns for the roles on a football team, with articles.

probes.prompt: How do you say 'goalkeeper' in Spanish?
Which word means 'striker': el delantero or el defensa?

title: Jugar in the present tense for football
text: Jugar is a stem-changing verb (u to ue): juego, juegas, juega, jugamos, jugáis, juegan. Jugar al fútbol means to play football. A2 football grammar.

concept.name: Jugar in the present tense
concept.description: Conjugating jugar (u>ue) to talk about playing football.

probes.prompt: Complete: Yo ___ al fútbol los sábados. (jugar)

title: Talking about a match in the past
text: Use the preterite for finished actions in a match: marcó un gol (scored a goal), ganamos el partido (we won the match), perdieron (they lost). A2 football grammar.

concept.name: Describing a match in the past
concept.description: Preterite forms for results and events of a match.

probes.prompt: Which form is past tense: 'marca' or 'marcó'?

title: Giving opinions about football
text: Express likes and preferences: me gusta el fútbol, me encanta el fútbol (I love football), mi equipo favorito es... A2 football opinions.

concept.name: Opinions with gustar and encantar
concept.description: Using gustar and encantar to talk about football preferences.

title: Reference: gustar and encantar
text:
Gustar and encantar agree with the thing that is liked, not with the person. Example: Me gustan los partidos de fútbol. Practice: Complete: Me ___ los partidos. (gustar) Answer: gustan.

Encantar expresses a stronger liking than gustar. Example: Me encanta el fútbol.

title: Reference: regular preterite endings
text: Regular -ar verbs take -é, -aste, -ó, -amos, -asteis, -aron in the preterite. Example: Marcó un gol en el último minuto. Practice: Translate: 'We won the match.' Answer: ganamos el partido.

title: Climate change vocabulary
text: Key nouns for talking about climate change: el cambio climático (climate change), el calentamiento global (global warming), las emisiones (emissions), los gases de efecto invernadero (greenhouse gases), la sequía (drought), las inundaciones (floods), la energía renovable (renewable energy). B1 climate change vocabulary.

concept.name: Climate change vocabulary
concept.description: Nouns for global warming, emissions, drought, floods and renewable energy, with articles.

probes.prompt: How do you say 'global warming' in Spanish?
Which word means 'drought': la sequía or la inundación?

title: Explaining causes and consequences
text: Connect causes and effects: debido a (because of), por eso (that is why), provocar (to cause), como consecuencia (as a consequence). Example: Las temperaturas suben debido a las emisiones. B1 climate change grammar.

concept.name: Causes and consequences
concept.description: The connectors debido a and por eso, and the verb provocar, that link a reason to its consequence.

probes.prompt: Complete: Las temperaturas suben ___ las emisiones. (debido a / por eso)
Which connector introduces a consequence: 'por eso' or 'porque'?

title: Saying what must be done
text: Express necessity and recommendations with es necesario que, es importante que and hay que. After es necesario que use the present subjunctive: es necesario que reduzcamos las emisiones. Hay que takes the infinitive: hay que reciclar. B1 climate change grammar.

concept.name: Necessity with the subjunctive
concept.description: Es necesario que + present subjunctive, and hay que + infinitive, to propose solutions.

probes.prompt: Complete: Es necesario que nosotros ___ las emisiones. (reducir)
Which is correct: 'Hay que reciclar' or 'Hay que reciclamos'?

title: Reference: the subjunctive after expressions of necessity
text:
Expressions of necessity such as es necesario que and es importante que take the subjunctive mood. Example: Es importante que usemos menos el coche. Practice: Complete: Es necesario que tú ___ agua. (ahorrar) Answer: ahorres.

Hay que is followed by the infinitive. Example: Hay que proteger los bosques.
